maddeler.e:
استنكروا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْكَرُوا (istankarū) /is.tan.ka.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
# اُسْتُنْكِرُوا (ustunkirū) /us.tun.ki.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
# اِسْتَنْكِرُوا (istankirū) /is.tan.ki.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
